bearing_a.encoding: uint8 heading leaving a towards b, in 360/256 degree steps

bearing_b.encoding: uint8 heading arriving at b from a, in 360/256 degree steps

degree.encoding: uint8 arms meeting at the junction, capped at 255

edge_access.encoding: uint8 bit 0: rideable a to b, bit 1: rideable b to a

edge_barriers.encoding: uint8 barriers passed inside this edge, weighted 1 slow and 2 stop

edge_class.encoding: uint8 bit 0: built for bicycles, bit 1: carriageway with a path beside it, bit 2: on a signposted cycle route

edge_crossings.encoding: uint8 uncontrolled crossings passed inside this edge

edge_grade.encoding: uint8 roughness of the unpaved part: 0 paved, 1 firm, 2 rough, 3 loose

edge_lit.encoding: uint16 decimetres explicitly tagged as lit

edge_name.encoding: uint32 index into name_blob's newline-separated list; 0 is unnamed

edge_shared.encoding: uint16 decimetres paved but shared with people on foot; disjoint from edge_unpaved, and the two together are the metres ridden at the slow-surface factor

edge_signals.encoding: uint8 traffic signals passed inside this edge

edge_traffic.encoding: uint8 motor traffic shared with: 0 none, 1 calm, 2 moderate, 3 busy, 4 arterial

edge_unpaved.encoding: uint16 decimetres ridden on a rough surface

name_blob.encoding: uint8 utf-8 street names, newline separated, the first one empty

node_barrier.encoding: uint8 barrier at the junction: 0 none, 1 squeeze past, 2 stop and put a foot down

node_kind.encoding: uint8 junction: 0 plain, 1 uncontrolled crossing, 2 traffic signal, 3 signal crossed in two stages

shape_count.encoding: uint16 interior points on this edge

shape_delta.encoding: uint16 zigzag deltas, lon and lat interleaved, degrees * 1e6; the first point of each edge is relative to node a, the rest to the previous point

shape_kind.encoding: uint8 kind of each shape point, as node_kind
